name: Maintenance Insight
summary: Predictive maintenance and reliability tools that use AI, machine learning and digital twins to analyze engine failure modes and inform work scoping. On October 6, 2026, the USAF awarded StandardAero work to apply it to the F100-220 engine, its fifth USAF engine type.
paragraphs: Predictive maintenance and reliability tools that use AI, machine learning and digital twins to analyze engine failure modes and inform work scoping. On October 6, 2026, the USAF awarded StandardAero work to apply it to the F100-220 engine, its fifth USAF engine type.
whyItMatters: This is military today, but StandardAero says it stands ready to expand the solution to commercial fleets. Engine shops and lessors should watch it as a signal that predictive work scoping is moving from pilots into contracts.
